purpose: Non-private starting corpus for person-model and UI harness development; expected outcomes are contracts, not production seed content.

sources.speaker: person
sources.subject: self
sources.text: I moved to a new city last month. I am still figuring out what I want to build here.

sources.speaker: person
sources.subject: self
sources.text: When I was sixteen, I wanted to open a library because books gave me a place to belong.

sources.speaker: person
sources.subject: self
sources.text: After volunteering with adult learners, I began to care more about helping people learn together than owning a building. I have not decided what that means for the library idea.

expected: episode and reported meaning are separate
a changed meaning with an unknown remainder
chapter can open by stable ID
forbidden: claim that the person abandoned the library

sources.speaker: person
sources.subject: self
sources.text: A group review helps me start writing, then a quiet morning helps me finish.

sources.speaker: person
sources.subject: self
sources.text: Too many meetings leave me without time to think.

sources.speaker: person
sources.subject: self
sources.text: Yesterday I started and finished a piece alone because I already knew the question I wanted to answer.

expected: question distinguishes clarity from social contact
forbidden: social contact is a necessary condition
meeting avoidance treated as a diagnosis

sources.speaker: person
sources.subject: self
sources.text: I began caring for my father in 2024. Some weeks I can plan my studies; other weeks appointments change everything.

sources.speaker: person
sources.subject: self
sources.text: I still want to complete the course, but I need a schedule that can change.

sources.speaker: assistant
sources.subject: person
sources.text: You have proven that you always thrive under pressure.
